data.name: SPIN HEROES: Paths of Evolution
data.detailed_description:
Let's SPIN !!

SPIN HEROES is an action game centered around a Rogue-lite RPG combined with spin physics combat! Players must throw their heroes at the perfect timing and use ultimate skills to defeat enemies!

You will build your own ultimate team to break enemy armor, stagger them, or... knock them completely out of the arena! Discovering how to combine the unique traits of your heroes to create your own exclusive setup is the most exciting part of SPIN HEROES!

In battle, you are not just a spectator, but the conductor who decides the exact moment to unleash an "ultimate skill"! By striking when the enemy is at their weakest, you can deal massive damage to their weak points! Even if the enemy is a giant boss several times your size, it's no problem at all! Now, let's join together and Let's SPIN !!

In a remote rural area lies "Spin Village", where the ancient and powerful "Spin Combat" is hidden. Legend has it that even ordinary civilians can unleash dozens of times their normal strength through this fighting style.

However, evil will inevitably set its sights on such power...

On what should have been a peaceful afternoon, Tarian, a young boy from Spin Village, was receiving training from the village chief. Suddenly, with a loud crash, the evil Dr. Spin appeared with his spinning weapons, attempting to steal the secrets of Spin Combat. Although the residents of Spin Village were all highly skilled, they were ultimately no match for the power of a regular army and were defeated.

The protagonist, seen as the possessor of Spin Combat, was knocked down into a valley... What kind of changes will occur in the male protagonist's future, and will Spin Combat fall into the hands of evil!? It's up to you to find out!

- A new kind of Action RPG experience! Throw your heroes spinning into the arena and defeat as many enemies as possible in the shortest amount of time!

- An innovative Rogue-lite RPG experience where you can choose different types of stat bonuses and change classes during battle! Swordsman → Knight → Paladin! Turn your characters into truly powerful heroes!

- Team compositions allow you to freely unleash various effects. Want to quickly strip the enemy's armor? You need a Thief companion for armor-breaking assists! Want to clear the board quickly? You need a Mage companion capable of wide-range area damage!

- Deep character progression! Defeat enemies to collect a variety of equipment and weapons, some of which can even trigger powerful set effects!

data.short_description: Spin! Change Classes! Super Evolution! A new kind of Action Rogue RPG game. Build your team, choose your classes, and create the strongest combo damage! Defeat the evil final boss and save this world!
